# ETPNav Reproduction Guide

## 🌟 Project Introduction (About)

> **Official open-source repository**: [MarSaKi/ETPNav](https://github.com/MarSaKi/ETPNav)
> **Paper link**: [ETPNav: Evolving Topological Planning for Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.03047v2) (This paper was published in the top-tier journal **IEEE TPAMI** in 2024)

**Statement: ETPNav is an excellent work proposed by Dong An et al., and currently serves as a strong baseline in the field of continuous environment visual language navigation (VLN-CE). This project and document mainly consist of detailed notes on challenges encountered and manipulation guides I compiled while studying and reproducing the official open-source project of ETPNav. I hope this clear, closed loop reference guide can assist researchers who wish to reproduce this work in the future.**

<p align="center">
  <img width="1044" height="287" alt="ETPNav展示1" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fad76d29-53fb-4f8f-aa66-8eb704f748de" />

</p>

Regarding the **ETPNav** (Evolving Topological Planning) algorithm itself, it primarily addresses the limitations of existing methods in long-distance planning and obstacle avoidance. It focuses on breaking through two core capabilities:

1. **Online mapping and long-distance planning**: The model does not need to explore the environment in advance, and a topological map can be dynamically built online using self-organized waypoints along the route. This enables the agent to decouple navigation tasks into high-level planning and low-level control. Based on this topological map, a cross-modal planner (based on Transformer) can better understand the instructions and generate long-distance navigation path plans.
2. **Obstacle avoidance control in continuous environments**: To address the complexity of continuous environments, ETPNav proposes a robust obstacle-avoidance controller (Tryout) based on trial-and-error heuristics, effectively preventing the agent from getting stuck in a deadlock due to collisions with obstacles in continuous environments.

## 1. Environment Configuration

This reproduction tutorial uses a Python 3.8 environment. Please follow these steps to configure the virtual environment and related dependencies:

### 1.1 Create a virtual environment and install PyTorch

```bash
# 创建并激活 conda 虚拟环境
conda create -n vlnce38 python=3.8
conda activate vlnce38

# 安装 PyTorch (1.9.1+cu111)
（方式一）
pip install torch==1.9.1+cu111 torchvision==0.10.1+cu111 \
-f https://download.pytorch.org/whl/torch_stable.html \
-i https://mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/pypi/simple

（方式二）
## 下载torch 1.9.1+cu111（Python3.8/Linux x86_64）
wget https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pytorch-wheels/cu111/torch-1.9.1%2Bcu111-cp38-cp38-linux_x86_64.whl

## 下载torchvision 0.10.1+cu111（匹配上面的torch版本）
wget https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pytorch-wheels/cu111/torchvision-0.10.1%2Bcu111-cp38-cp38-linux_x86_64.whl

pip install torch-1.9.1+cu111-cp38-cp38-linux_x86_64.whl torchvision-0.10.1+cu111-cp38-cp38-linux_x86_64.whl
```

### 1.2 Installing Project Dependencies

Download `requirements.txt`: [ Baidu Netdisk ](https://pan.baidu.com/s/1PU1pm596QtL8ZNG08602Dg) (extract code: `8je8`)

```bash
pip install "pip<24.1" setuptools==65.5.0 wheel==0.38.4
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
```

### 1.3 Installing the Habitat simulator

(1) Download the pre-compiled package of Habitat-sim v0.1.7 without a header version: [ Click to download ](https://anaconda.org/aihabitat/habitat-sim/0.1.7/download/linux-64/habitat-sim-0.1.7-py3.8_headless_linux_856d4b08c1a2632626bf0d205bf46471a99502b7.tar.bz2)
(2) Download habitat-lab v0.1.7 [ Click to download ](https://github.com/facebookresearch/habitat-lab/releases/tag/v0.1.7)
```bash
# 安装 habitat-sim
conda install habitat-sim-0.1.7-py3.8_headless_linux_856d4b08c1a2632626bf0d205bf46471a99502b7.tar.bz2

# 安装 habitat-lab
cd habitat-lab-0.1.7
pip install -e .
```
### 1.4 Fixing Environment Dependencies for Cloud Server (Optional)

When running the Habitat simulator in a cloud container or a lightweight Linux system, issues such as the lack of a graphics rendering library (`OpenGL/EGL` error) and version conflicts in the C++ underlying libraries (`CXXABI` error) often occur. Please follow these steps in order to resolve them simultaneously:

**1. Install system-level graphics rendering dependencies (to resolve the "missing libEGL library" error)**

The underlying 3D engine Magnum of Habitat requires the following libraries to initialize properly:

```bash
apt-get update
apt-get install -y libopengl0 libgl1-mesa-glx libglib2.0-0 libegl1
```

**2. Upgrade the system-level C++ standard library (to resolve CXXABI errors)**

```bash
# 安装管理 PPA 源的工具
apt-get install -y software-properties-common

# 添加 ubuntu-toolchain-r 测试源
add-apt-repository ppa:ubuntu-toolchain-r/test -y
apt-get update

# 仅升级系统的 C++ 标准库
apt-get install --only-upgrade libstdc++6 -y
```

### 1.5 Download the original ETPnav-main code
[ Offline download ](https://github.com/MarSaKi/ETPNav)
```bash
# 克隆仓库
git clone https://gh-proxy.org/https://github.com/MarSaKi/ETPNav.git
```


## 2. Dataset Download

### 2.1 Scene Data (Scenes): Matterport3D (MP3D)

Download the Matterport3D scene reconstruction data. There are 90 scenes in total, and the dataset size is approximately 22GB. The final storage path should be: `data/scene_datasets/mp3d/{scene}/{scene}.glb`

* **Method 1: Download the official script** (requires Python 2.7)
  Please visit the [ official project homepage ](https://niessner.github.io/Matterport/) of Matterport3D, and follow the instructions on the page to obtain the official download script `download_mp.py`.
  ```bash
  python download_mp.py --task habitat -o data/scene_datasets/mp3d/
  ```

* **Method 2: Quick download from cloud storage**
  * Link: [ Baidu Cloud Storage ](https://pan.baidu.com/s/1XRXDsRhg4j09nHxXBe9boA)
  * Extraction code: `4kz6`

### 2.2 Task Data (Episodes): R2R & RxR

Please place the downloaded Episode data in the `data/datasets` directory.

| Dataset | Download Link | Storage Path |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **R2R_VLNCE_v1-2_preprocessed** | [Google Drive](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1j9sQ0w4wFYSafh42U8VCuKTwMrnrsV6z/view) | `data/datasets` |
| **R2R_VLNCE_v1-2_preprocessed_BERTidx** | [Baidu Cloud Storage](https://pan.baidu.com/s/1Sz7Q7iXcLV7ToQ0FeZmHIg) (Extract code: `88yy`) | `data/datasets` |
| **RxR** | [Baidu Cloud Storage](https://pan.baidu.com/s/1WZwKwdBt0ofdmuTKmWjHSQ) (Extract code: `g317`) | `data/datasets` |

### 2.3 Connectivity Graphs

Visualization connectivity graph files:
* **Download link**: [connectivity_graphs.pkl](https://github.com/jacobkrantz/VLN-CE/blob/master/data/connectivity_graphs.pkl)
* **Storage path**: `data/connectivity_graphs.pkl`

## 3. Model weights and pre-trained data

Please download the corresponding encoder weights, predictor weights, and pre-trained feature files as required, and place them in the specified directory.

### 3.1 Encoder and Component Weights

| Model Component | Download Link | Target Storage Path |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Waypoint Predictor (R2R-CE)** | [[Original project link ](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1goXbgLP2om9LsEQZ5XvB0UpGK4A5SGJC/view)] | `data/wp_pred/check_cwp_bestdist_hfov90` |
| **Waypoint Predictor (RxR-CE)** | [[Original project link ](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1LxhXkise-H96yMMrTPIT6b2AGjSjqqg0/view)] | `data/wp_pred/check_cwp_bestdist_hfov63` |
| **BERT Weights** | [Huggingface](https://huggingface.co/google-bert/bert-base-uncased/tree/main) | `bert_config/bert-base-uncased` |
| **RGB Encoder (ViT-B32)** | [Huggingface](https://huggingface.co/jinaai/clip-models/blob/main/ViT-B-32.pt) | `.cache/clip/ViT-B-32.pt` |
| **Depth Encoder (ResNet50)** | [Gibson Pretrained](https://dl.fbaipublicfiles.com/habitat/data/baselines/v1/ddppo/ddppo-models/gibson-2plus-resnet50.pth) | `data/pretrained_models/ddppo-models/gibson-2plus-resnet50.pth` |

### 3.2 Pretraining Data

* **R2R pre-trained data**: [ download link ](https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/4iaw2ii2z2iupu0yn4tqh/AP2waOdlwdbJE5sUti2557U/R2R?dl=0&rlkey=88khaszmvhybxleyv0a9bulyn&subfolder_nav_tracking=1) $\rightarrow$ stored in `pretrain_src/datasets/R2R`
* **Pre-computed visual features**: [ download link ](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1D3Gd9jqRfF-NjlxDAQG_qwxTIakZlrWd/view) $\rightarrow$ stored in `pretrain_src/datasets/img_features`
* **LXMERT pre-trained weights**: [ download link ](https://nlp.cs.unc.edu/data/model_LXRT.pth) $\rightarrow$ stored in `pretrain_src/datasets/pretrained/LXMERT`

### 3.3 Final Pretrained Weights

If you want to skip the pre-training stage, you can directly download the provided pre-trained weights:

* **Storage path**: `pretrained/ETP/model_step_82500.pt`

## 4. Code Execution

### 4.1 Pretraining

(If you want to skip this step, you can use the pre-trained weights downloaded earlier and directly perform fine-tuning or evaluation.)

1. **Modify the reference path**: If the external network is unreachable, replace the BERT weight address with a local one.
   <p align="center">
     <img width="1566" height="444" alt="修改引用路径" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/47b99ba4-f96a-441b-82d4-0b117a2ba452" />
   </p>

2. **Adjust the number of GPUs**: Adjust the number of GPUs for distributed training according to actual hardware conditions.
   <p align="center">
     <img width="1148" height="349" alt="修改 GPU 数量" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0336bc2b-9ae6-4294-9f73-105646ff49b9" />
   </p>

3. **Start pre-training**: This step mainly performs the two pre-training tasks: MLM (Masked Language Modeling) and SAP.
   ```bash
   CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 bash pretrain_src/run_pt/run_r2r.bash 233
   ```
    The training logs will be saved in `/ETPNav-main/pretrained/r2r_ce/mlm.sap_habitat_depth/logs/log.txt`. You can select the best pre-trained weights based on the actual evaluation metrics:
   <p align="center">
     <img width="395" height="260" alt="预训练日志" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/321a4a31-4fb1-420a-b40c-a1540ab5d82a" />
   </p>

### 4.2 Fine-tuning (Finetuning)

1. **Configure pre-trained weight path**: Point the loading path in the script to `pretrained/ETP/model_step_82500.pt`.
   <p align="center">
     <img width="1019" height="499" alt="配置预训练权重路径1" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5b51f709-6b75-439e-993f-f4d714e8a879" />
     <br>
     <img width="1123" height="497" alt="配置预训练权重路径2" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0c85ccfa-e76c-4518-8919-bd1246734127" />
   </p>

2. **Adjust the number of GPUs**: Adjust the number of GPUs for distributed training according to the actual hardware conditions.
   <p align="center">
     <img width="1060" height="434" alt="修改GPU数量1" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1bf9004e-4991-411c-8b7c-92150f8ec5c4" />
     <br>
     <img width="1337" height="333" alt="修改GPU数量2" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e45b0d7e-7b7b-431b-a760-37830c0dee95" />
   </p>

3. **Initial tuning**:
   **Note**: It takes approximately 1.5 days for a single RTX 4090 card to complete the tuning process.
   ```bash
   CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 bash run_r2r/main.bash train 2333  # training
   ```
4. **Disable TensorFlow warnings** (optional):
  export TF_ENABLE_ONEDNN_OPTS=0
  export TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=2


### 4.3 Testing and Evaluation (Eval & Testing)

#### Evaluation

Run the following command for evaluation:

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 bash run_r2r/main.bash eval  2333  # evaluation
```
